result.summary: Add undo data for block 413567 to benchmark test data and write it during test block index setup. This ensures that the RPC blockchain benchmarks for blockToJSON at verbosity level 3 exercise undo data reading, fee calculation, and prevout serialization.
result.problem: The `blockToJSON` RPC helper requires undo data to populate prevouts and calculate transaction fees. Because the benchmark harness lacked undo data for the sample block, `TxVerbosity::SHOW_DETAILS` (verbosity 2) and `TxVerbosity::SHOW_DETAILS_AND_PREVOUT` (verbosity 3) performed identical work, giving an inaccurate benchmark of verbosity 3 performance.
evidence: PR description benchmarks show that before the change, `BlockToJsonVerbosity2` ran in 17.07 ms/op and `BlockToJsonVerbosity3` ran in 17.25 ms/op (virtually identical), whereas with undo data available verbosity 3 increases to 34.27 ms/op as it processes prevouts.
result.scope_notes: Adds a binary raw data file (`src/bench/data/block413567_undo.raw`, ~136 KB).
result.card: This PR adds undo data for block 413567 to benchmark fixtures so that `blockToJSON` can read prevouts and calculate fees during benchmarks. Previously, the lack of undo data meant `BlockToJsonVerbosity3` (requesting prevouts) performed the exact same work as verbosity 2, masking the true cost of prevout extraction and serialization. Benchmark data in the PR description shows verbosity 3 runtime jumping from ~17.2 ms/op (identical to verbosity 2) to ~34.3 ms/op once undo data is actually processed.
